nodes.title: Positive
widgets_values: A head and shoulders portrait for a magazine cover featuring a beautiful young woman with a playful, rebellious expression. She has a wide, genuine smile while sticking her tongue out, showcasing a high-spirited personality. Her face is dusted with a dense constellation of natural freckles across her nose and cheeks. Her eyes are a rich, multi-tonal brown hazel with visible iris textures and bright catchlights. She wears her dark hair in two slightly tousled pigtails. Her makeup is bold and dark, featuring heavy charcoal eyeshadow and smudged kohl liner that contrasts with her joyful expression. The lighting is soft and diffused, emanating from a large overhead softbox to create gentle shadows and highlight the micro-textures of her skin. Shot on 35mm analog film using an 85mm prime lens at f/2.2, the image features a shallow depth of field that softly blurs the background. Authentic film grain, Kodak Portra 400 color science, and a sharp focus on the eyelashes and skin pores provide a raw, high-end photographic aesthetic.
